title: SEMP in Risk and Compliance Management in Banking
description: The SEMP in Risk and Compliance Management in Banking builds expertise in banking risk, compliance, and governance.
longDescription: This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of risk and compliance within the commercial banking sector. It explores core risk management principles, international banking regulations, and governance practices. Learners gain insight into identifying, analysing, and managing risks across banking operations. The course emphasises practical application to support sustainable and compliant banking practices. We don’t just give you the theory; we ensure you learn how to apply it in your working life immediately, with case studies, webinars, business simulations, and 100% project-based. The Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in risk and compliance within the commercial banking sector allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The purpose of this programme is to deliver practical and realistic solutions to the challenges to the risk management experts, which in turn is supported by appropriate reference to theoretical and conceptual analysis.
courseDetails: The course covers commercial bank management and the fundamentals of risk management in banking operations. It examines international banking regulations and their impact on compliance and governance. Learners explore procurement risk and contract management within regulated financial environments. The programme focuses on risk identification and analysis techniques relevant to banking. Practical risk management strategies are discussed to support informed decision-making. Emphasis is placed on aligning risk practices with regulatory expectations. Course Details: Commercial Bank Management: Examines the structure, functions, and management practices of commercial banking institutions. Fundamentals of Risk Management: Introduces core concepts, principles, and frameworks used to identify and manage risk. International Banking Regulation: Explores global regulatory standards and their impact on banking operations and compliance. Procurement Risk and Contract Management: Focuses on identifying and managing risks associated with procurement and contractual obligations. Risk Identification and Analysis: Develops skills to recognise, assess, and prioritise risks using systematic approaches. Risk Management Strategies: Covers practical strategies for mitigating, transferring, accepting, or avoiding organisational risks. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 10 ECTS.
